046/** Test cases for the Elasticsearch query visitor. */
047public class OccurrenceEsQueryVisitorTest {
048
049  private static final OccurrenceSearchParameter PARAM = OccurrenceSearchParameter.CATALOG_NUMBER;
050  private static final OccurrenceSearchParameter PARAM2 =
051      OccurrenceSearchParameter.INSTITUTION_CODE;
052
053  private static final ObjectMapper objectMapper = new ObjectMapper();
054
055  private final EsFieldMapper<OccurrenceSearchParameter> fieldMapper =
056      new OccurrenceEsFieldMapperTest();
057  private final OccurrenceEsQueryVisitor visitor =
058      new OccurrenceEsQueryVisitor(fieldMapper, "defaultChecklistKey");
059
060  private void assertQueryEquals(String expectedJson, String actualQuery)
061      throws JsonProcessingException {
062    JsonNode expected = objectMapper.readTree(expectedJson.trim());
063    JsonNode actual = objectMapper.readTree(actualQuery);
064    assertEquals(expected, actual);
065  }
066
067  @Test
068  public void testEqualsPredicate() throws QueryBuildingException, JsonProcessingException {
069    Predicate p = new EqualsPredicate<>(PARAM, "value", false);
070    String query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
071    String expectedQuery =
072        "{\n"
073            + "          \"bool\": {\n"
074            + "            \"filter\": [\n"
075            + "              {\n"
076            + "                \"term\": {\n"
077            + "                  \"catalog_number.keyword\": {\n"
078            + "                    \"value\": \"value\"\n"
079            + "                  }\n"
080            + "                }\n"
081            + "              }\n"
082            + "            ]\n"
083            + "          }\n"
084            + "        }\n";
085    assertQueryEquals(expectedQuery, query);
086  }

110  @Test
111  public void testEqualsDatePredicate() throws QueryBuildingException, JsonProcessingException {
112    Predicate p = new EqualsPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE, "2021-09-16", false);
113    String query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
114    String expectedQuery =
115        "{\n"
116            + "          \"bool\": {\n"
117            + "            \"filter\": [\n"
118            + "              {\n"
119            + "                \"range\": {\n"
120            + "                  \"event_date\": {\n"
121            + "                    \"gte\": \"2021-09-16\",\n"
122            + "                    \"lt\": \"2021-09-17\",\n"
123            + "                    \"relation\": \"within\"\n"
124            + "                  }\n"
125            + "                }\n"
126            + "              }\n"
127            + "            ]\n"
128            + "          }\n"
129            + "        }\n";
130    assertQueryEquals(expectedQuery, query);
131
132    // An InPredicate should be exactly the same
133    p = new InPredicate<>(OccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE, Arrays.asList("2021-09-16"), false);
134    query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
135    expectedQuery =
136        "{\n"
137            + "          \"bool\": {\n"
138            + "            \"should\": [\n"
139            + "              {\n"
140            + "                \"bool\": {\n"
141            + "                  \"filter\": [\n"
142            + "                    {\n"
143            + "                      \"range\": {\n"
144            + "                        \"event_date\": {\n"
145            + "                          \"gte\": \"2021-09-16\",\n"
146            + "                          \"lt\": \"2021-09-17\",\n"
147            + "                    \"relation\": \"within\"\n"
148            + "                        }\n"
149            + "                      }\n"
150            + "                    }\n"
151            + "                  ]\n"
152            + "                }\n"
153            + "              }\n"
154            + "            ]\n"
155            + "          }\n"
156            + "        }\n";
157    assertQueryEquals(expectedQuery, query);
158
159    p =
160        new InPredicate<>(
161            OccurrenceSearchParameter.EVENT_DATE, Arrays.asList("2021-09-16", "2024-01-17"), false);
162    query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
163    expectedQuery =
164        "{\n"
165            + "          \"bool\": {\n"
166            + "            \"should\": [\n"
167            + "              {\n"
168            + "                \"bool\": {\n"
169            + "                  \"filter\": [\n"
170            + "                    {\n"
171            + "                      \"range\": {\n"
172            + "                        \"event_date\": {\n"
173            + "                          \"gte\": \"2021-09-16\",\n"
174            + "                          \"lt\": \"2021-09-17\",\n"
175            + "                    \"relation\": \"within\"\n"
176            + "                        }\n"
177            + "                      }\n"
178            + "                    }\n"
179            + "                  ]\n"
180            + "                }\n"
181            + "              },\n"
182            + "              {\n"
183            + "                \"bool\": {\n"
184            + "                  \"filter\": [\n"
185            + "                    {\n"
186            + "                      \"range\": {\n"
187            + "                        \"event_date\": {\n"
188            + "                          \"gte\": \"2024-01-17\",\n"
189            + "                          \"lt\": \"2024-01-18\",\n"
190            + "                    \"relation\": \"within\"\n"
191            + "                        }\n"
192            + "                      }\n"
193            + "                    }\n"
194            + "                  ]\n"
195            + "                }\n"
196            + "              }\n"
197            + "            ]\n"
198            + "          }\n"
199            + "        }\n";
200    assertQueryEquals(expectedQuery, query);
201  }

636  @Test
637  public void testDisjunctionPredicate() throws QueryBuildingException, JsonProcessingException {
638    Predicate p1 = new EqualsPredicate<>(PARAM, "value_1", false);
639    Predicate p2 = new EqualsPredicate<>(PARAM2, "value_2", false);
640    Predicate p3 = new EqualsPredicate<>(PARAM, "value_3", false);
641
642    DisjunctionPredicate p = new DisjunctionPredicate(Arrays.asList(p1, p2, p3));
643    String query = visitor.buildQuery(p);
644    String expectedQuery =
645        "{\n"
646            + "          \"bool\": {\n"
647            + "            \"should\": [\n"
